description: Best-of-N uber-prompt synthesis feature across N conversational columns before and after grading.
prompt: /arm-new-track packages/bon_rater/armature/ I want to add an uber-prompt synthesis feature that combines the best information from all N columns into a unified response, available both before grading (as an alternate option to grading) and after grading on the grades dashboard.

user_responses.response: Support both Pre-Grading and Post-Grading synthesis modes.
Adopt the split: broadcast to all pre-grading, target winning column post-grading.
Skip errored columns and block dispatch until all active columns finish.
Option C: Full peer evaluations plus access to raw candidate snippets for borrowing code.
Pass top 2 candidate responses raw and summarize the remaining candidates.
Instruct the model to highlight conflicting recommendations and arbitrate between them.
Place [Synthesize All] next to [Evaluate Responses], and clicking it immediately cancels the 3-second countdown.
Show WIP spinner on the winning card during refinement, and reveal a 1-click [Copy Refined Master] button upon completion.
(Recommended) Reaffirm decisions — trade-offs are acceptable, proceed to spec.
(Recommended) Record ADR: Dual-mode synthesis split and peer evaluation integration.
(Recommended) Yes, materialize spec and manual testing runbook.

description: Migrating JSON column to strongly-typed relational table with zero-downtime dual-writing.

user_responses.response: Adopt synchronous dual-writing on the write path with shadow-read verification.
Log and alert on secondary table write failures without blocking primary JSON writes.
Record discrepancies in metrics table and treat the legacy JSON column as authoritative during transition.
Run an idempotent offline batch job chunked by shard ID with rate limiting to backfill historical records.
Gate read cutover behind a feature flag so we can instantly roll back to JSON reads.
(Recommended) Reaffirm decisions — trade-offs are acceptable, proceed to spec.
(Recommended) Record ADR: Synchronous dual-writing with shadow-read verification.
(Recommended) Yes, materialize spec and manual testing runbook.

description: Splitting monolithic GraphQL User schema into federated subgraphs with Apollo Router.
prompt: /arm-new-track services/user_service/conductor/ split monolithic GraphQL User schema into federated UserProfile and UserSecurity subgraphs with Apollo Router.

user_responses.response: Use @key(fields: "id") on User and move sensitive auth fields to UserSecurity subgraph.
Enforce strict unidirectional dependency: UserProfile may reference UserSecurity, but UserSecurity never queries UserProfile.
Return partial null for UserSecurity fields with GraphQL error extensions while returning 200 with full UserProfile.
Use optional presence wrappers to differentiate unset fields from default zero-values.
(Recommended) Reaffirm decisions — trade-offs are acceptable, proceed to spec.
(Recommended) Record ADR: Unidirectional dependency and GraphQL error extensions.
(Recommended) Yes, materialize spec and manual testing runbook.
